_comment: Synthetic, verification-only fixture -- NOT a real model. Has no real conv params (kernel size, stride, padding, weights/bias) so it is not valid input to baseline.py or topology_builder.py. It exists purely to exercise cosma_Ilp.py's spill/retrieve logic and visualize_spm.py's rendering with a genuine, non-degenerate spill/retrieve, which no currently-exported real model triggers (see cosma/ITERATION_HISTORY.md). Models a skip connection (tensor 10, produced at t=0, not needed again until t=3) coexisting with an unrelated local computation (tensors 11->12 at t=1->2). compute_structural_minimum_bytes = 200 bytes @ t=2; compute_mpmf_bytes = 210 bytes @ t=2.
